Method of Attack: Software supply chain attack via tainted Windows installers and macro-laden Office documents
Use of 'XSL Script Processing' technique to fetch and execute malicious XSL scripts via wmic.exe
Execution of VBScript to create files and folders in %ProgramData%, connect to C2 server, and establish persistence via rogue scheduled task
Attack Vector: Tainted Windows executable installer repackaged with Nullsoft Scriptable Install System (NSIS)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious XSL script fetched from rogue FTP server
Rogue scheduled task named 'activate' under 'Office 365__\Windows\Office' directory
